summary.headline: The v3 headline bug (FA-ENG-1) is fixed and verified: the January intake now adds exactly 15 unsigned independents and zero jobbers, so the stated model (60 start / 15 per year 1996-2001 / 90 entering / 23 scripted / 37 jobbers) holds exactly - 150 generated indies and 37 jobbers measured after the final 2001 class. FA-ENG-4 is resolved as moot by the same fix. 9 of the 11 v3 engine findings remain open (most importantly FA-ENG-2: generated indies still can never be signed by anyone), plus 1 new cosmetic finding (FA4-1).

fix_verification.current_value: v3 finding: the January intake re-ran the whole generator, adding 37 signed local jobbers every January 1996-2001 (259 jobbers by 2001 instead of 37; ~312 generated entrants instead of 90)
fix_verification.recommended_value: RESOLVED at de2dc15: generateWorldTalent gained an includeJobbers flag defaulting to false (js/engine.js L266), the jobber loop early-returns unless it is set (L328-330), and only newGame passes true (L253) - jobbers are now seeded exactly once, at world creation
fix_verification.explanation: Verified empirically: (a) fresh game = 408 wrestlers (311 seeded + 60 indies + 37 jobbers); (b) a player-run simulation to t252 and a spectate simulation to t300 both show jobbers pinned at exactly 37 with the turn-0 per-fed distribution intact (NJPW 4, AJPW 4, AJW 5, CMLL 3, AAA 3, USWA 3, ASW 3, FMW/WWC/SMW/NWA/CWA/AWF 2 each); (c) zero jobbers created after turn 0; (d) all six January classes 1996-2001 fire (indyClassYear [1996,1997,1998,1999,2000,2001], final class at turn 291), producing exactly 60 + 6 x 15 = 150 generated independents - the stated design (60 start / 15 per year / 90 entering / 23 scripted / 37 jobbers) now holds exactly. Determinism is preserved for fresh games: the includeJobbers=true path consumes the RNG in the same order as before, so the same seed still yields the same world. The fix comment ("Seed local jobbers once at the opening of the world; annual classes are unsigned independent graduates only") matches the corrected intent precisely.

free_agent_corrections.current_value: The January intake re-runs the ENTIRE generator: generateWorldTalent(state, 15) at js/engine.js L3361 also executes the unguarded INDY_JOBBERS_PER_FED loop at L329-333, adding 37 signed local jobbers every January 1996-2001
free_agent_corrections.recommended_value: Split the function - e.g. generateIndyClass(state, n) that skips the jobber loop - or pass an options object ({ pool: 15, jobbers: false }). Keep the 37 jobbers as a single turn-0 seeding.
free_agent_corrections.explanation: The headline defect of the revision. Measured: each January 1996-2000 adds +15 unsigned indies AND +37 signed local jobbers (NJPW +4/yr -> 20 by 1999, AJW +5/yr -> 25, CMLL/AAA/USWA/ASW +3/yr -> 15 each). By end-2001 the world carries 259 generated jobbers instead of 37, inflating every mid-card fed payroll and contradicting the documented design ("90 total generated wrestlers gradually entering"; the new-game hint promises only the 15/year). Historical note: real NJPW/AJPW/AJW undercards did not gain 4-5 permanent local hands per year.

The engine functions accept indies (signFreeAgent/placeBid succeed when called directly), so this is a reachability defect, not a data defect.
